favourite.heading: Why Texas can pull away
bullets: Texas is the better football team by 9.9 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+9.9 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 5.2 points to Texas (+5.2 pts).
Playing at Texas is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Texas by 0.2 points: ball control vs front disruption (+0.2 pts).

underdog.heading: Why UTSA can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -3.5 to p90 +40.5 for Texas, so a projection of +19.5 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
60% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
